description: `ComponentProvenance` proto in `packages/proto/schemas/ui-health/v1/contracts/provenance.proto` defines the canonical adoption-metadata shape. The SQLite store in `react-component-library` is authoritative; the JSDoc block on adopted source files is the heal-from signal. Both round-trip losslessly with the proto message.

requirements.description: A `ComponentProvenance` protobuf message must be defined in `packages/proto/schemas/ui-health/v1/contracts/provenance.proto`. It is the single source of truth for adoption metadata and must include at minimum: adoption_status enum (CUSTOM, ADOPTED_UNMODIFIED, ADOPTED_MODIFIED, UNKNOWN), library, library_version, source_sha256, and drift_hash fields. The SQLite store in `react-component-library` is authoritative for runtime data, and the JSDoc block on adopted source files is the heal-from signal. Both must round-trip losslessly with the proto message.
requirements.title: ComponentProvenance Proto as Canonical Adoption Metadata Shape

validation.notes: Proto file compiles without errors using protoc
All required fields (adoption_status, library, library_version, source_sha256, drift_hash) are present in the proto definition
AdoptionStatus enum values CUSTOM, ADOPTED_UNMODIFIED, ADOPTED_MODIFIED, UNKNOWN are defined
A ComponentProvenance message serialized from a SQLite row deserializes back to identical field values (round-trip test)
A ComponentProvenance message serialized from a JSDoc block deserializes back to identical field values (round-trip test)
Read a row from the SQLite adoption store, convert to ComponentProvenance proto, serialize to binary, deserialize, and compare all fields
Parse a JSDoc provenance block from an adopted source file, convert to ComponentProvenance proto, and confirm all fields are populated correctly
All ui-health subsystems (validate, search, reindex) reference this proto as the shared contract for provenance data

requirements.description: The SQLite adoption store in `react-component-library` must be the authoritative source for ComponentProvenance data. The JSDoc block on adopted source files must serve as the heal-from signal. Both representations must map to and from the ComponentProvenance proto without data loss, ensuring consistency between the two stores.
requirements.title: SQLite Store and JSDoc Block Provenance Round-Trip Fidelity

validation.notes: SQLite adoption row schema includes columns for all ComponentProvenance proto fields
JSDoc block parser extracts all ComponentProvenance fields from a well-formed JSDoc comment
JSDoc block writer serializes all ComponentProvenance fields into a well-formed JSDoc comment
Round-trip: SQLite → proto → SQLite produces identical row data
Round-trip: JSDoc → proto → JSDoc produces identical comment content
Simulate adoption of a component, write JSDoc block, read it back via parser, and confirm proto field equality with the originating SQLite row
Confirm that a missing JSDoc block on an adopted file triggers a DRIFT finding during validation
Developers can recover authoritative provenance state by reading JSDoc blocks when the SQLite database is lost or corrupted

title: ComponentProvenance contract is single source of truth
